Title: See only my articles
Text: As a customer, I want to see only my articles, so that I do not scroll through items I cannot order.
AcceptanceCriteria: Only articles on my price list are shown

Title: See my own prices excluding VAT
Text: As a customer, I want to see my own prices excluding VAT, so that I can calculate my order.
AcceptanceCriteria: Prices come from my price list
Prices are shown excluding VAT

Title: Search and filter the catalogue
Text: As a customer, I want to search and filter the catalogue, so that I find an article quickly on my phone.
AcceptanceCriteria: Search finds articles by name and number

Title: Add articles with quantities to an order
Text: As a customer, I want to add articles with quantities to an order, so that I can order what I need.
AcceptanceCriteria: Lines can be added, changed and removed

Title: See the cut-off time and my delivery day
Text: As a customer, I want to see the cut-off time and my delivery day, so that I know when my order arrives.
AcceptanceCriteria: The 18:00 cut-off is visible
Orders after 18:00 move to the next delivery day of the route

Title: See the delivery fee for a small order
Text: As a customer, I want to see the delivery fee for a small order, so that I am not surprised at checkout.
AcceptanceCriteria: Below CHF 150 a CHF 25 fee is shown before submitting

Title: Repeat my last order in one tap
Text: As a customer, I want to repeat my last order in one tap, so that I do not rebuild the same order every week.
AcceptanceCriteria: The last order is one tap from the start screen
The copy can be edited before submitting

Title: Be told which articles are no longer available
Text: As a customer, I want to be told which articles are no longer available, so that I can replace them before I submit.
AcceptanceCriteria: Unavailable articles are flagged

Title: Receive a confirmation email
Text: As a customer, I want to receive a confirmation email, so that I know the order went through.
AcceptanceCriteria: The email lists articles, quantities and delivery day

Title: Receive the same confirmation
Text: As a member of the order desk, I want to receive the same confirmation, so that I can follow every incoming order.
AcceptanceCriteria: The order desk address receives each confirmation

Title: Change a customer order before 18:00
Text: As a member of the order desk, I want to change a customer order before 18:00, so that I can fix mistakes without a new order.
AcceptanceCriteria: Lines and quantities can be edited until 18:00
Changes after 18:00 are refused

Title: See who changed an order and when
Text: As a member of the order desk, I want to see who changed an order and when, so that I can answer customer questions.
AcceptanceCriteria: Each change shows the person and the time

Title: Get a CSV file of all confirmed orders each evening
Text: As a member of the order desk, I want to get a CSV file of all confirmed orders each evening, so that the ERP imports them without retyping.
AcceptanceCriteria: The file is ready for the 18:30 import
Each order appears exactly once

Title: See changed orders in the export
Text: As a member of the order desk, I want to see changed orders in the export, so that the ERP matches what the customer gets.
AcceptanceCriteria: Changed and cancelled orders are reflected

Title: See the status of my order
Text: As a customer, I want to see the status of my order, so that I do not have to phone the order desk.
AcceptanceCriteria: Status is received, picked, on the way or delivered

Title: Update the status of an order
Text: As a member of the order desk, I want to update the status of an order, so that customers see where their order is.
AcceptanceCriteria: A status change shows the time it happened

Title: Choose a delivery time window
Text: As a customer, I want to choose a delivery time window, so that the delivery fits my kitchen.
AcceptanceCriteria: One window can be chosen per order

Title: See the chosen window on the order
Text: As a member of the order desk, I want to see the chosen window on the order, so that I can plan the routes.
AcceptanceCriteria: The window is shown on the order
